# ZhangMin.name

> Terminal-style portfolio for ZhangMin.name, an AI engineer focused on AI Native workflows, backend engineering, and distributed systems.

## Profile

- Name: ZhangMin.name
- Role: AI Engineer
- Location: Hangzhou, China
- Website: [zhangmin.name](https://zhangmin.name/)
- GitHub: [zhangmin510](https://github.com/zhangmin510)

## Selected projects

- An interactive Chinese field guide to the DeepSeek Harness runtime, workflows, public cases and plugin ecosystem. [DeepSeek Harness Atlas](https://zhangmin.name/panoramas/deepseek-harness/)

- A Chinese reference to benchmarks reported by OpenAI, Anthropic and Google across three years, with examples, metrics, methods and linked model results. [Benchmark Atlas](https://zhangmin.name/panoramas/model-benchmark-atlas/)

- A Chinese interactive guide to twelve Mac mini workflows across six settings, including desktop work, home servers, and local AI. [Mac mini use cases](https://zhangmin.name/panoramas/mac-mini-use-cases/)
- A Chinese interactive history of Grand Theft Auto traces the release timeline, the changing depictions of Liberty City, Vice City and Los Santos, and the series’ game design. [GTA series panorama](https://zhangmin.name/panoramas/gta-series/)
- [RSI panorama](https://zhangmin.name/panoramas/recursive-self-improvement/): Chinese interactive field guide to recursive self-improvement, with six conceptual layers, twelve research references, four step-by-step instructional cases, and an illustrative feedback simulator.

- [Frontier Benchmarks](https://github.com/zhangmin510/frontier-benchmarks): Chinese benchmark explorer covering 23 evaluations of frontier OpenAI and Anthropic models.
- [2×2 Cube Lab](https://zhangmin.name/cube-guide/): interactive Chinese tutorial with diagrams, formula playback, a draggable 3D cube, quizzes, and local progress tracking.
- [MeetingCopter](https://github.com/zhangmin510/MeetingCopter): macOS meeting reminder MVP built with Swift 6.
- [obsidian-podium](https://github.com/zhangmin510/obsidian-podium): Obsidian plugin that presents existing Markdown notes as fullscreen slides with adaptive pagination and annotation tools.
